resolution_notes: base_url: incorrect as original. Official Client Portal Web API docs (https://www.interactivebrokers.com/campus/ibkr-api-page/cpapi-v1/) document the REST base as the local Client Portal Gateway path https://localhost:5000/v1/api after login, not a public cloud host. Verifiers A/B both correct; no current official source supports https://api.ibkr.com/v1/api as the documented public base URL.
